title: Read an entity’s source history
responsibility: Reads up to 100 Git commits affecting a unit’s owned source paths at the requested revision.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.root
inputs.description: The repository directory in which to read Git history.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.revision
inputs.description: The Git revision from which to read history, passed as supplied to Git.

inputs.name: catalogHistory.unit
inputs.description: The unit definition whose owned source paths restrict the history. No owned paths means an empty history without running Git.

outputs.name: catalogHistory
outputs.description: A promise for commit history entries containing the hash, author timestamp and subject, with no design version. Each entry states that source changed and verification is recorded separately. Git read failures reject the promise.
